assistant: The FAQs about COVID Vaccine Myths document addresses several common misconceptions about the COVID-19 vaccine. Here are three key points from the document:
1. COVID-19 vaccines do not interact with or change your DNA in any way.
2. Receiving a COVID-19 vaccine will not make you magnetic as they do not contain ingredients that can produce an electromagnetic field.
3. None of the COVID-19 vaccines authorized for use in the United States shed or release any of their components.

[The Start of Current Turn Question]
how does COVID-19 Vaccines work?
[The End of Current Turn Question]

[The Start of Reference Answer]
Vaccines are a safer way for your body to learn to make antibodies. COVID-19 vaccines work by training your body's natural immune system to recognize and fight the virus that causes COVID-19. When the vaccine is introduced to your body, it stimulates a response to the virus, causing your body to make antibodies that help kill or neutralize the virus. If you're exposed to the actual virus in the future, these antibodies will help your immune system recognize and fight the virus quickly, preventing serious illness.
The vaccines teaches your cells how to make a protein that triggers an immune response. Once your cells have finished using the instructions, they break down the mRNA and get rid of it.
You can learn more about how COVID-19 vaccines work on the CDC website.
[The End of Reference Answer]
